summary: Frontend-only testing of TASCK OS v3 — 10 new features (topbar, notifications, dark mode, Command+K, tasks, users, brainstorm, feedback, scope changes, contract preview, settings toggles, brand enquiry, brand onboarding, contracts tab, role selector enquiry link) verified end-to-end on preview URL. V1 and V2 still load. All 18 requested scenarios PASS (100%).

design_issues.screen: V3 Admin — Tasks, Users (and previously Project Detail tables)
issues: React hydration warnings persist from the preview's visual-edit instrumentation: '<span> cannot be a child of <select>' on V3AdminTasks (span wraps each <option> produced by v3RMs.map), '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' on V3AdminUsers (span wraps each <tr> produced by filtered.map). Same root cause as iteration_10 — the <span data-ve-dynamic style=display:contents> wrapper is injected around .map()-produced children; visually renders correctly. Safe to ignore for demo; only dev-console noise.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Silence hydration warnings by avoiding direct .map() → <option>/<tr> output in V3AdminTasks.js (line 81 select, line 84 option map) and V3AdminUsers.js (line 97 tbody, line 99 tr map). Suggest extracting each mapped row/option into a tiny named component so the visual-edit instrumentation wraps the component mount point instead of wrapping the <tr>/<option> with a <span>. Zero functional impact; only clears dev-console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: V3Layout.js (141 lines) — clean separation; topbar nicely extracted. darkMode is local state; consider lifting to a React context or localStorage if persistence across route changes between portals is desired (currently resets when navigating to /v3 or switching portal).

V3NotificationCenter.js — hard-coded 8 notifications is fine for demo; good data-testid coverage (notif-n1..n8, notification-bell, notification-panel). Outside-click overlay uses fixed inset-0 which is correct.
V3CommandK.js — search is case-insensitive and covers projects, brands, creators. Uses e.key === 'k' with metaKey||ctrlKey — works on mac & windows. ESC to close works.
V3AdminSettings.js — good: reminders state fully interactive, inputs disable when toggle is off. data-testid on every reminder row is helpful.
V3AdminContractPreview.js renders all 10 clauses within V3DocumentSurface — no long-scroll issues observed.
Overall no files exceed 700 lines; data-testid coverage on all new interactive elements is excellent.
test_credentials: Not required — all V3 routes are publicly accessible
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 new premium features for V3 are fully functional and verified end-to-end: topbar (search/dark-mode/bell), notification center (8 items, 3 unread, navigation works), Command+K palette (keyboard + click), dark mode class toggle, admin tasks page (filters, RM assignee), admin users page (role tabs, avatars), campaign workspace/brainstorm, brand feedback (9.8/10 with 5 sub-scores), scope changes (approved + under-review workflows), contract preview (10-clause document), interactive settings reminders (6 toggles + day inputs), brand enquiry form, brand onboarding wizard, and project-detail Contracts tab. V1 and V2 remain intact. Only outstanding noise is the previously-known hydration warning from the preview's visual-edit instrumentation wrappers — now extended to <option>/<tr> maps in V3AdminTasks and V3AdminUsers. Cosmetic only.
rca of the issue: No functional issues. Hydration warnings continue to stem from the preview visual-edit instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'> around every .map()-produced child. When the mapped child is an <option> inside <select> or a <tr> inside <tbody>, HTML spec forbids <span> as that parent's child, and React logs a hydration warning. display:contents makes the span invisible to layout, so rendering is correct. Mitigation (if desired): wrap each mapped element in a tiny named subcomponent — the instrumentation wraps the component mount instead of the <tr>/<option> itself.
